title: Notifications
description: Choose where alerts about new bookings, public-booking requests, and account activity should land.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.subtitle: Get Telegram pings when bookings start or assignments end.
telegram.pressStart: Open the bot and press Start
telegram.manualInstructions: Send /start to the bot, copy the Chat ID, paste here
telegram.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to connect Telegram notifications.

email.title: Email notifications
email.subtitle: Where reservation and account activity emails should land.
email.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to configure email notifications.
email.masterDesc: Master switch — disable to silence every email below.
email.dailyDigestDesc: Summary of bookings starting and assignments ending tomorrow.
email.bookingAlertsDesc: Instant email when someone submits a public booking.
email.lifecycleDesc: Occasional check-ins if you haven't used OhMyDesk in a while.

community.title: Community Telegram Group
community.subtitle: Broadcast announcements and updates to your members in a shared Telegram group or channel.
community.instructions: Add @OhMyDesk_bot to your group as an admin, then paste the group's Chat ID (supergroups start with -100).
community.broadcastPlaceholder: Write an announcement to your members (e.g. events, opening hours, community news)...
community.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to configure community Telegram announcements.
